performance.verdict: Organic-only account; GBP and search both contracting — no paid floor to catch it.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — no Meta, no Google Ads — so CPL and ROAS are structurally undefined; all lead generation is absent.
GBP actions collapsed 84% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 13-15) show 0 actions vs prior 3 days (Sep 10-12) averaging 1.3/day — confirming the drop is not recovering.
Search clicks down 33% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 13-15) total 0 clicks vs prior 3 days (Sep 10-12) totaling 5 — a confirmed 3-day contraction, not noise.
GA4 sessions relatively stable (-4.88% WoW, ~6/day average) despite search click collapse; suggests direct or referral traffic masking search decay — source split unknown.
GBP call rate is 0.57% against 350 impressions over 28 days; only 2 calls generated — profile conversion quality is weak even when impressions exist.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions and search clicks for 3 more days; if both remain at 0, escalate GBP optimisation to Sohib immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for 3 consecutive days (Sep 13–15) after an 84% WoW decline, and search clicks also reached 0 over the same window (vs 5 clicks in the prior 3 days). No paid activity exists to compensate for organic contraction. Success check: if GBP actions and search clicks do not recover to a combined 3+ per day by 2026-09-19, flag for immediate GBP profile review and paid activation discussion with the client.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP profile for suppression or category changes that could explain the sudden 84% action drop and near-zero impressions trend.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP generated only 42 actions over 28 days with a call rate of 0.57% (2 calls from 350 impressions), and the last 3 days show 0 actions — a structural collapse, not a blip. Check for profile suspension flags, duplicate listings, recent category edits, or a Google-side suppression event. Confirm resolution by 2026-09-19 with impressions returning above 15/day and at least 1 action recorded.
